A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and their schemas.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' src, service_name, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 p95_ms FROM abnormal_traces WHERE attr_span_kind='SPAN_KIND_SERVER' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm' src, service_name, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs, avg(duration)/1e6, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 FROM normal_traces WHERE attr_span_kind='SPAN_KIND_SERVER' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1
SELECT DISTINCT attr_span_kind, attr_status_code, count(*) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT 'abn' src, service_name, attr_span_kind kind, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,1) p95_ms FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm' src, service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), round(avg(duration)/1e6,1), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,1) FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

input.query: SELECT 'abn' src, service_name, level, substr(message,1,160) msg, count(*) n FROM abnormal_logs GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', service_name, level, substr(message,1,160), count(*) FROM normal_logs WHERE level<>'INFO' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, attr_status_code, attr_http_response_status_code, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-auth-service','ts-ui-dashboard') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.query: WITH a AS (SELECT metric, service_name s, avg(value) av, max(value) amax FROM abnormal_metrics GROUP BY 1,2), n AS (SELECT metric, service_name s, avg(value) nv, max(value) nmax FROM normal_metrics GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT coalesce(a.metric,n.metric) metric, coalesce(a.s,n.s) svc, round(nv,2) normal_avg, round(av,2) abn_avg, round(nmax,2) nmax, round(amax,2) amax FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN n ON a.metric=n.metric AND a.s=n.s WHERE abs(coalesce(av,0)-coalesce(nv,0)) > 0.2*greatest(abs(coalesce(nv,0)),1) ORDER BY 1,2
